ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: Image description: In the figure, quadrilateral ABCD is a slanted rhombus, with vertex A at the upper left, B at the upper right, C at the lower right, and D at the lower left. Diagonals AC and DB are both drawn and intersect at point P; there is a right-angle mark near P, indicating that the two diagonals are perpendicular at P. Reasoning: ∠DPC is the angle composed of PD and PC, where PD is on diagonal DB and PC is on diagonal AC. The diagonals of a rhombus are perpendicular to each other, so m∠DPC = 90°. The problem gives m∠DPC = 3x - 15, therefore 3x - 15 = 90. Solving gives 3x = 105, x = 35.

method.method_draft: Read the diagram as rhombus ABCD with diagonals AC and DB drawn intersecting at P; angle DPC is the angle at P between PD, a part of diagonal DB, and PC, a part of diagonal AC. method.method_draft: Read the diagram as AC and DB intersecting at P, with D, P, B collinear and A, P, C collinear; ∠DPC is therefore the angle between segment DP and segment PC. From the text, ABCD is a rhombus, so it is a parallelogram with all sides equal. Since rhombus diagonals bisect each other, P is the midpoint of AC. In triangle ADC, AD = DC, so triangle ADC is isosceles with base AC; DP lies on diagonal DB and passes through the midpoint P of AC. The median from the vertex D of an isosceles triangle to the base AC is perpendicular to AC, so DP ⟂ PC and m∠DPC = 90°. Then 3x - 15 = 90, giving x = 35.
method.CoT_raw:
图像描述：图中是四边形 ABCD，顶点 A 在左上，B 在右上，C 在右下，D 在左下，外形为菱形。对角线 AC 和 DB 都画出，并在内部交于点 P；从图上可见 D、P、B 共线，A、P、C 共线，∠DPC 是由射线 PD 和 PC 组成的角。

推理：题目给出 ABCD 是菱形，所以它也是平行四边形，菱形的对角线互相平分，因此 P 是 AC 的中点。又因为菱形四边相等，所以在三角形 ADC 中，AD = DC，三角形 ADC 是以 AC 为底边的等腰三角形。DP 位于对角线 DB 上，并经过底边 AC 的中点 P，所以 DP 是等腰三角形 ADC 中从顶点 D 到底边 AC 的中线。等腰三角形顶角到底边中点的中线垂直于底边，因此 DP ⟂ AC。由于 PC 在 AC 上，所以 DP ⟂ PC，故 m∠DPC = 90°。由题意 3x - 15 = 90，解得 3x = 105，x = 35。
